components.name: Filled button
components.description: The screen's one main action: a glossy pill in the theme accent.
components.css: .ds-btn-filled { min-height: 48px; padding: 0 20px; border: none; border-radius: 999px; background: #C54315; color: #fff; font: 600 15px/22px Rubik, system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(197,67,21,0.2); } .ds-btn-filled:hover, .ds-btn-filled:active { background: #B53E14; } .ds-btn-filled:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(197,67,21,0.3); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Tonal button
components.description: The button on a card in a list, and every secondary action.
components.css: .ds-btn-tonal { min-height: 48px; padding: 0 20px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.95); border-radius: 999px; background: rgba(255,233,221,0.8); color: #A9461E; font: 600 15px/22px Rubik, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-btn-tonal:hover, .ds-btn-tonal:active { background: #FFE9DD; } .ds-btn-tonal:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(197,67,21,0.3); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Card
components.description: A translucent white surface with a bright edge and a theme-tinted shadow.
components.html: Grab bread on your way homeFrom Mum
components.css: .ds-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; padding: 16px; border-radius: 22px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.86); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.95); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(197,67,21,0.05), 0 6px 18px rgba(197,67,21,0.08); font-family: Rubik, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-card-title { font: 600 16px/25px Rubik, system-ui, sans-serif; color: #1D1B1A; } .ds-card-meta { font: 400 14px/21px Rubik, system-ui, sans-serif; color: #5E5955; }

components.name: Chip
components.description: An answer to pick; selected fills with the theme ink.
components.css: .ds-chip { min-height: 40px; padding: 0 14px; margin-right: 8px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid #E6DAD0; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.86); color: #1D1B1A; font: 600 14px/21px Rubik, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-chip:hover { background: #FFE9DD; } .ds-chip-on { background: #A9461E; border-color: #A9461E; color: #fff; } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(197,67,21,0.3); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text field
components.description: A labelled box; focus wears the theme colour and a soft ring.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; } .ds-field-label { font: 600 14px/21px Rubik, system-ui, sans-serif; color: #5E5955; } .ds-field-input { min-height: 52px; padding: 0 16px; border-radius: 14px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.95); background: rgba(255,255,255,0.96); color: #1D1B1A; font: 400 17px Rubik, system-ui, sans-serif; outline: none; } .ds-field-input::placeholder { color: #6C6762; } .ds-field-input:focus-visible { border-color: #C54315; background: #fff; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(197,67,21,0.16); }

components.name: Segmented switch
components.description: Switches between two or three views of one screen.
components.css: .ds-seg { display: flex; min-height: 44px; padding: 3px; border-radius: 999px; background: rgba(197,67,21,0.07); } .ds-seg-part { flex: 1; border: none; border-radius: 999px; background: transparent; color: #5E5955; font: 600 14px/21px Rubik, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-seg-part:hover { color: #1D1B1A; } .ds-seg-on { background: #fff; color: #1D1B1A; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(197,67,21,0.05), 0 6px 18px rgba(197,67,21,0.08); } .ds-seg-part:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(197,67,21,0.3); }

narrative.northStar: The friend's notebook on a sunny table
narrative.overview: Zaki is an Operate surface: people come to do one small job with one hand. The look is light and warm. A soft mesh of the user's theme sits behind every screen; everything the user reads or taps sits on white cards that let a breath of that colour through. Ink is near-black. The theme's own colour is spent on few things: the one filled button, the raised chat button in the middle of the tab bar, numbers on tiles, quiet buttons and the active tab.
keyCharacteristics: Light mesh ground, white translucent cards, near-black ink.
Geometry is round: cards 22, sheets and dialogs 28, fields 14, every button and chip a pill.
Colour identifies: one Ionicon per meaning, in a square tinted by kind.
Motion is small: a 220 ms fade and 10 px lift, once; loading keeps the page's shape.
Full RTL; Egyptian Arabic first; Latin digits in both languages.
No blur, gradient or SVG native module: mesh and Zaki art are images; motion is core Animated.

rules.name: The Fill-Not-Words Rule
rules.body: primary is a fill and an icon colour, never small text. Words in the theme's colour use primary-ink.

rules.name: The Kind Rule
rules.body: An icon's square says what the thing is about (money, people, place, alarm), not which screen it is on. Kind colours never change with the theme.

rules.name: The 4.5 Rule
rules.body: Text is 4.5:1 or more on a card and on the mesh in all three themes. Re-compute after changing a theme colour or a mesh.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Rubik only (owner decision). Hierarchy comes from size and weight, never from a second face, letter-spacing or capitals.

rules.name: The Latin Digits Rule
rules.body: Numbers are Latin digits in Arabic too.

rules.name: The Tinted Shadow Rule
rules.body: Depth carries a little of the theme; a neutral grey shadow is not part of this system.

rules.name: The Edge-On-Colour Rule
rules.body: The bright edge only shows on the mesh. On white, a line is line-strong and a quiet fill is wash.

dos: Do put every colour through palette / kind and every text through Text with a role.
Do keep one filled button a screen; a card that comes in a list uses tonal or outline.
Do use line-strong for a line and wash for a quiet fill inside a white card.
Do use Segmented to switch views and Chip for an answer to pick.
Do give every touchable a 48 target (height or height plus hit slop).
Do colour an icon's square by kind and keep one Ionicon per meaning across the app.
Do write numbers in Latin digits and let rows mirror in Arabic; mirror arrows through Icon.
Do keep motion to opacity and position with core Animated, and honour reduce motion.
donts: Don't use primary for small text; use primary-ink.
Don't add a second type family, a gradient, blur or SVG native module.
Don't put emoji on buttons, chips or titles.
Don't add helper sentences under a title, row, button or field.
Don't use a grey shadow, or the bright edge as a line on white.
Don't change kind, family, friends or Session colours with the theme.
Don't call Session therapy or give it the app's playful ground: it keeps its calm mesh.
